title: QA run · surface:browser (61/61) · 316be321 · 2026-10-04 · 38 PASS / 8 PARTIAL / 15 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
17.7 pre-release verification, browser half: every runnable `surface:browser` item against `origin/main` as it stood when the browser run started, with the Console built from the bumped pin (#21710). 17.7 is not cut yet, and the packages still read 17.6.0. The non-browser half is #21720 (subject `251a7dd4`). `surface:mixed` gets its own record against the same subject. Text only. Screenshots were consulted live as oracles and are not attached. The durable truth stays in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/`.

## Environment fingerprint

- **Framework (subject):** `objectstack-ai/objectstack` **`316be321`** (`fix(runtime)!: an app-authored body may not read the stored-metadata tables; it reaches them through the metadata API only (#21594) (#21660)`). This is 25 commits past `251a7dd4` and includes the console pin bump #21710. It ran in a dedicated detached worktree. Framework and console both built, and a smoke boot answered health 200 and `/_console` 200.
- **Console:** built from objectui pin **`2e818d0b51ec`** (`.objectui-sha`, #21710). Every lane checked that the dist stamp equals the pin. Console source questions were read at that revision (`git show 2e818d0b51ec:{path}`). For the "predates 17.6.0" notes, the 17.6.0 references are framework `617f25f8a` and objectui pin `31971ff1e`.
- **Checklist:** items, `RUNNER.md` and `scripts/checklist-select.mjs` come from the subject tree. The table gives every item's revision, and each one matches `areas/*.json`.
- **App / boots:** `examples/app-showcase` booted with `OS_PORT={p} objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p {p} -d file:/tmp/qa1770fe/{lane}/{item}.db`. Each item had its own file DB, and lanes used disjoint port ranges inside 44101–45909 (the egress proxy port 41333 was excluded). The browser was Playwright on `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`. Admins signed in through the console form, so both the bearer and the cookie halves existed. Members were minted with admin `invite-member` + `sign-up/email` or with `admin/create-user` + `change-password`. Identity was proven with `GET /auth/get-session` before each persona cell. Scratch fixtures were authored at runtime inside each item's own DB, or in a scratch copy of the showcase under `/tmp`.
- **Deviations, stated:**
  - **CRM package in the shared tree.** Lane FE2 installed the CRM package (`os package install`, needed for the marketplace item) into the shared subject `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages/` from 12:28 to 12:36Z. FE1's boots on 44105–44108 (account-app-entry, docs-portal-render, home-admin-cluster-links, url-overlay-contract) started in that window and registered `crm_app` next to the three stock apps. None of their clauses depends on the app list, so the clauses are unaffected. FE2 removed the package through the API, and lanes were ordered from then on to install only into scratch copies.
  - **One shared DB in FE2.** Seven FE2 items ran on one boot with one shared `main.db`: keyboard, theme, installability, palette, ai-gating, api-console, and marketplace boot A. As a result, the api-console tree also listed `Data: crm_*` groups.
  - **Port moved in FE4.** One FE4 item moved from 44408 to 44409 because the session process held 44408 as an outbound ephemeral port.
- **Execution:** this selector was run by six parallel runner subagents (FE1–FE6). Independent verifiers VF1–VF4 checked the results under RUNNER rule 7, and VF3 and VF4 re-derived every fail in this selector. Everything ran in Claude Code session `session_018zT8d8NpiQ1ExhuNd5TxY6`. The lanes ran on 2026-10-04 from 12:06Z, and verification finished on 2026-10-05. After an earlier overload of the box, concurrency was capped at three lanes (a maintainer order), with verifiers counted as lanes. Tier-1 pins that live in this repository were run and are cited in the table. Items whose `automated.ref` lives only in objectui were driven by hand as manual browser runs (RUNNER environment facts, option a).

## Scope

`node scripts/checklist-select.mjs surface:browser --json` returned **61 runnable** items. One item is hidden as blocked and was not run: `approvals.quorum-m-of-n`. The selector returned no planned items. All 61 items received a verdict.

- **4 carry a verified product defect**, all in the objectui console and all predating 17.6.0. One of the four, marketplace-console-honesty, also carries a stale clause.
- **2 are held:** the runner observed a fail and reproduced it, but the verifier could not confirm the mechanism, so no card is filed and a live re-run is owed.
- **1 is a known expected-fail probe only** (keyboard-shortcut-surface, K1a / K1b).
- **8 fail on checklist clauses only.** ai-gating's A6 there is also the known expected-fail K2.

One more defect lies outside the clauses (dashboards.chart-type-matrix, which passes) and is extracted with the four.

- VF4 refuted action-location-matrix A1 (now invalid pairing).
- VF3 ruled that chart-type-matrix A8's clause holds and the mislabel lies outside it.
- VF4 recorded inbox-metadata-actions A2 and global-filters-rescope A6 as stale clauses.

One item verdict is derived differently from its lane's summary: form-dirty-guard is PARTIAL rather than pass, because its A3 pin is objectui-only and was not run (RUNNER per-item derivation).

## Fails — reproduction rules and dispositions

### Product defects

**platform-core.shell-nav-personalization A3** {card-1}: drag-reorder is never offered on grouped navigation, and every stock app's navigation is grouped.
- **Server truth:** the served `GET /api/v1/meta/app?id=showcase_app` navigation is grouped (8 groups), and so are the Setup and Account navigations.
- **Browser:**
  1. Sign in as admin.
  2. Open `/_console/apps/showcase_app/showcase_task`.
  3. Hover and try to drag any sidebar entry.
- **Expected:** a grip, and an order that is restored after reload (useNavOrder, localStorage `objectui-nav-order-showcase_app`).
- **Actual:** 0 `[aria-label="Drag to reorder"]`, no sortable, and the localStorage key is never written. Seen on two loads.
- **Root cause (VF4):**
  - objectui `NavigationRenderer.tsx:1590` computes `hasGroups`.
  - The DndContext / SortableNavigationItem path exists only in the `!hasGroups` arm (`:1614-1631`). The grouped arm (`:1650` ff.) renders plain items.
  - `UnifiedSidebar.tsx:583` passes `enableReorder={!isMobile}` unconditionally.
  - `useNavOrder` persists only `__root__`.
- **Predates 17.6.0:** identical at objectui `31971ff1e`.
- **Verifier VF4:** CONFIRMED, P3. If the maintainers rule that reorder is meant for flat navigation only, the clause becomes an assertion defect; VF4's corrected wording is with the re-point.

**platform-core.marketplace-console-honesty A3** {card-2}: on an offline boot, the installed package's Details page is a dead end, so reseed and purge cannot be reached from the console.
- **Server truth:**
  - Boot with `OS_CLOUD_URL=off`. `/runtime/config` reports `marketplace:false`.
  - `os package install examples/app-crm/dist/objectstack.json -r http://localhost:{p}`. Installed Apps then lists `com.example.crm` v4.0.0.
- **Browser:**
  1. Go to Setup → Installed Apps. The row offers Refresh / Details / Uninstall.
  2. Click Details. It opens `/system/marketplace/com.example.crm`.
- **Expected:** reseed / purge affordances that issue `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/com.example.crm/{reseed,purge}-sample-data`.
- **Actual:** the page renders "App Marketplace is turned off" and makes 0 install-local wire calls. Seen twice.
- **Root cause (VF4):**
  - objectui `InstalledListWidget.tsx:155` links Details to `/system/marketplace/:packageId`.
  - `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx:568` returns the `MarketplaceDisabled` card before the page reaches its local reseed/purge menu (`:752`).
- **Predates 17.6.0:** identical at objectui `31971ff1e`.
- **Verifier VF4:** CONFIRMED, P3.
- **Related:** the endpoint behind the purge affordance has its own defect, #21728 (purge answers 500), which is scored by the api lane.

**records-forms.view-type-gallery A2** {card-3}: the kanban board never renders its `summarizeField` per-column totals.
- **Server truth:**
  - The fixture board `showcase_task.board` declares `{groupByField:'status', summarizeField:'estimate_hours'}` (`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/views/task.view.ts:262-275`).
  - Summing `estimate_hours` per status over `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task` gives backlog 30 / todo 36 / in_progress 100 / in_review 54 / done 24.
- **Browser:** as admin, open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/view/showcase_task.board`.
- **Expected:** those five totals in the column headers.
- **Actual:** the headers show only the count badge ("BACKLOG 2" … "DONE 2"), and the board's data request selects no `estimate_hours`. Seen twice by the runner and twice by the verifier, all on fresh loads.
- **Root cause (VF3):**
  - Nothing in objectui `packages/plugin-kanban/src` reads `summarizeField` (column header around `KanbanImpl.tsx:1066-1100`).
  - The only consumers, `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:2002` and `:2517`, add the field to the projection.
  - The spec declares the key at `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:1789` with no liveness verdict, making it an ADR-0049 declared-but-unenforced key.
- **Predates 17.6.0:** no reader at objectui `31971ff1e` either.
- **Verifier VF3:** CONFIRMED, P3.

**records-forms.grid-personalization A2** {card-4}: the row height (density) is lost on reload.
- **Browser:**
  1. As admin, open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task`. The runner also used `…/view/showcase_task.grid`.
  2. Click "Density: Compact (click to cycle)". It changes to "Comfortable" and rows go from 41 px to 45 px.
- **Server truth:**
  - The console sends `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.default` and gets 200 "Saved customization overlay".
  - The body is the whole served item (`config{…}`, `_provenance`, `scope`, `_diagnostics`) with a flat top-level `"rowHeight":"medium"`.
  - Afterwards, `GET /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.default` carries no `rowHeight`, either at top level or in `config`.
  - A reload in a fresh context shows "Density: Compact" again.
- **Expected:** the chosen row height survives reload.
- **Control:** the same item PUT with `config.rowHeight:"tall"` reads back `"rowHeight":"tall"`.
- **Root cause (VF3):**
  - objectui `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:1181` `buildPersistedViewBody` spreads the patch at the envelope top level instead of into `config`, for views the switcher classes as saved views.
  - The framework save door stores only the declared keys of a view body (ADR-0005 appendix (c)), so it drops the misplaced key while still answering 200. Dropping it is by design, so the fix belongs to the client.
  - VF3 adds a design note: a 200 that silently discards an undeclared envelope key is a silent-loss shape, and a save diagnostic would have surfaced it.
  - `sort` and `hiddenFields` patches probably take the same path (not driven).
- **Predates 17.6.0:** identical at objectui `31971ff1e`.
- **Verifier VF3:** CONFIRMED, P2.

**dashboards.chart-type-matrix, outside the item's clauses** {card-5}: a `previousPeriod` comparison on the dataset path is labelled "vs yesterday". Clause A8 passes because the comparison renders; only the label is wrong.
- **Server truth:**
  1. As admin, `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/qa_compareto_probe?mode=draft` with:
     - `dateRange:{field:'created_at', defaultRange:'last_30_days'}`;
     - a metric widget on dataset `showcase_task_metrics`, `values:['task_count']`, `compareTo:{kind:'previousPeriod'}`.
  2. `POST …/publish`.
  3. The dataset query shifts the whole 30-day window (`timeDimensions` dateRange `[2026-09-04, 2026-10-04]`, `task_count__compare: 1`).
- **Browser:** open `/_console/apps/showcase_app/dashboard/qa_compareto_probe`.
- **Expected:** "vs previous period".
- **Actual:** the metric shows "9 ↑800%" with the label "vs yesterday", and the line legend reads "Tasks · vs yesterday".
- **Root cause (VF3):**
  - objectui `packages/core/src/utils/compare-to.ts:124-136` `compareToTrendLabelKey` derives the label by regex-sniffing the raw filter for macro tokens (`today` → `vsYesterday`).
  - `plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx:1097` reuses it on the ADR-0021 dataset path, where the executor shifts the dimension window (`service-analytics` `dataset-executor.ts:810-819` `shiftRange`).
  - The heuristic is only right on the inline path.
- **Predates 17.6.0:** the same code is at objectui `31971ff1e`.
- **Verifier VF3:** CONFIRMED by code (not live-driven). P3.
- **Evidence strength:** the runner observed it once.

### Held: observed, not verified, not extracted

**i18n.surface-matrix A1 (relative-dates variant) and i18n.studio-follows-app-locale A3:** dates render in the browser's language when the app locale code is the language-only `zh`.
- **Server truth:** `GET /api/v1/i18n/translations/zh-CN` is the expectation set.
- **Browser:**
  1. Fresh boot. Create a Chromium context with `locale:'en-US'`.
  2. Set `localStorage['objectui-locale']='zh'` before the first load. This is the code `i18n.notification-localized-and-clears` tells runners to write.
  3. Sign in as admin and open `/_console/apps/showcase_app/showcase_task`.
- **Expected:** date cells in zh, like the rest of the page.
- **Actual:**
  - Headers are zh, but due-date cells read "Sep 16", "Oct 24", "In 3 days" next to "逾期 6 天".
  - The record page reads "截止日期 Sep 16" next to "创建于 20天前".
  - The bell's activity tab reads "12 seconds ago".
- **Discriminators:**
  - The same `zh` session in a zh-CN browser renders 9月16日 / 3天后.
  - The code `zh-CN` (what the LocaleSwitcher writes) renders zh in an en-US browser.
  - `html lang` is `zh` in the failing case and `zh-CN` in the passing one.
  - Flipping the tenant locale has no effect (A/B on the same boot).
- **Reproduction count:** 2 fresh boots × 3 loads.
- **Studio-specific note:** Studio's own timestamps follow the app locale under `zh-CN`. The studio clause fails only through the shared formatter.
- **Verifier VF3: UNCONFIRMED.**
  - The code contradicts the stated mechanism. `useDisplayLocale` passes `zh` to `Intl` verbatim, and the date-fns resolution maps it to zh-CN.
  - VF3 did not render live.
  - VF3 found a different possible cause: an unconfigured tenant's `en-US` default from `GET /api/v1/auth/me/localization` outranks the UI language. A tenant locale of `zh` itself is refused by settings.
- **Disposition:** held. The observation stands, the mechanism is disputed, and no card is filed. A live re-run of both items is owed (RUNNER rule 7). If the observation stands, the defect belongs to the objectui console. It predates 17.6.0 by code.

### Checklist clauses (no product defect)

Each of these was seen by a runner outside the clauses. They are low severity or possibly by design, and they are listed so they are not lost:

- `GET /api/v1/data/{object}?top=0` answers `total:0` while `top=1` gives the real total, and the console sends `top=0` as its record-count probe. Two lanes saw it (FE3, FE4).
- A malformed JSON body on `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_task` is treated as an empty body: the answer is 400 "Title is required; Project is required", not a parse error.
- CSV export renders booleans as hard-coded 是 / 否 regardless of locale, under English headers.
- On New, select options marked `default: true` are not pre-selected (invoice status / region), so "Status is required" blocks create. Separately, an edit save wrote `region:"amer"` into a row whose region was null.
- A wizard default form renders flat, with no step chrome, in the New modal. Only the `/new` page route honours it.
- The action-param dialog is taller than the viewport with no scroll (top at y=-198), so Confirm cannot be reached at 1440×900 or 1600×1200.
- The Log Time form dispatch leaves the app shell, heads the page with the raw target "showcase_task.form", and toasts "Action completed successfully" before any submit.
- Line amounts are computed in floating point and never rounded (3598.7999999999997).
- Related-list pages and inline-grid child fetches carry no sort, so their page order relies on natural order.
- The Field Zoo row tint does not paint the frozen #/Name columns.
- Record History shows a currency change unformatted ("— → 4250000"), while the grid shows "$4,250,000.00".
- After the submitter has approved as an approver, the approvals drawer still says "only the assigned approvers can approve or reject".
- The approvals drawer opened on an unknown `?request=` id leaves an empty "Approval Request" sheet behind the correct toast.
- `showcase_invoice` shows two fields both labelled "Owner" (the system `owner_id` and its own `owner`).
- The record feed shows an admin's PATCH as authored by "System". The `inlineEdit` grid renders two "Actions" header columns.

- The home-navigation block in `UnifiedSidebar` (Home, Documentation, the Administration cluster) has no rendering surface. VF4 also notes this and suggests an item revision rather than a defect.

- Selecting a theme command in the palette (Dark / Light / System) leaves the palette open. Navigation commands close it.
- The connection chip shows nothing after a backend loss mid-session. A single aborted `/api/v1/discovery` at load strands the splash at "Preparing workspace" for 45 s or more, with no retry and no error.
- The PWA manifest icon type is hard-coded `image/svg+xml` even when the favicon is a PNG.
